title: ctenopteris geluensis
intro: Ctenopteris geluensis, commonly known as the Mountain Horsetail or Flicking Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from fever, rheumatism, and various other health issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ctenopteris geluensis include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in soothing skin irritations and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects, although more research is needed for a comprehensive understanding.
